units_note: Each brand stores measurements in the units its own chart publishes. Convert for display only; never rewrite a stored value.

sizing_rule.statement: Where bust, waist and hips map to different sizes, recommend the largest of the three.

support.source: Maggie Sottero — Sizing and Special Lengths
support.says: If measurements fall between sizes, order the larger size. For ballgowns the smaller size may be ordered if only the hip matches the larger one.

support.source: The Knot — The Ultimate Guide to Wedding Dress Sizes
support.says: A gown can typically be taken in about two sizes but let out by only one.

street_size_context.claim: Bridal sizing runs roughly three sizes larger than street/high-street sizing; the system derives from 1940s European sizing.
street_size_context.source: The Knot — The Ultimate Guide to Wedding Dress Sizes
street_size_context.do_not: Do not present this as a second hard size. Label it an approximation and cite the source on screen.

brands.notes: Azazie publishes several charts; this is the WD (wedding dress) series. The brand also publishes A-series, junior bridesmaid, flower girl and maternity charts which are NOT used here. Azazie additionally offers custom sizing.

Hollow-to-hem values on the source page had inconsistent unit labelling and are therefore NOT included. Capture them manually before building the length feature.

brands.notes: Official brand PDF. Brand states these are guidelines and that fit points vary by style. Standard lengths are measured from the natural waist to the floor, NOT hollow-to-hem, so they are not interchangeable with Azazie length values.
